fix1_rayleigh_vs_brody.note: Brody does NOT contain the 2D Rayleigh distribution. KS distance quantifies the functional-form mismatch. Despite this, beta correctly ranks processes by exclusion strength.

fix2_psi_revolutions.note: Modify generate_psi_ceramic_figure.py to process each revolution independently. Expected: beta_1..beta_5 ~ 2.0 ± 0.1 each.

fix3_density_control.note: Domains have different densities. Density-controlled comparison requires subsampling to matched density and recomputing beta. Recommended: subsample primes to match PSI density (~0.032) and verify beta remains ~2.15.

fix4_synthetic_validation.method: Synthetic height fields with Gaussian peaks + 3% prominence detection + Brody MLE
fix4_synthetic_validation.note: Pipeline correctly orders processes by beta (CSR < Strauss < HC-moderate < HC-strong) and approximately recovers the expected beta values. Recovery ratio ~0.7-0.9 suggests systematic underestimation due to peak detection inefficiency, but ranking is preserved.

fix5_spatial_bootstrap.note: Spatial bootstrap: randomizing peak positions within the convex hull and recomputing beta would provide a null distribution. If beta(observed) > 95th percentile of beta(null), the spatial structure is statistically significant. For primes, the Bernoulli null at matched density provides this comparison: beta=0.74 vs 2.15, confirming structure.
